pr_title: Add unit inference for Amps and VA in APCUPSD integration
pr_body:
## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->

This PR adds unit inference for `Amps` and `VA` in APCUPSD integration which was accidentally dropped due to unit inference logic update in #93724.

New tests for these two units are added to prevent future regression. Moreover, an extra assert is added to the `init_integration` (also renamed to `async_init_integration` for better consistency with HA naming styles) helper function in tests to ensure the integration is correctly set up.

review_comments:
"New tests for these two units are added to prevent future regression."

Are these the new tests?🤔

Yes, this tests if our unit inference can properly split the `Amps` from `0.88 Amps` (and subsequently convert `Amps` to `UnitOfElectricCurrent.AMPERE` in HA). Without the fix in this PR this would result in the following error:
